submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
ONE full-body transparent production animation sprite of the exact SAME water-dragon scholar boy, CAST E07, one independently drawn pose, NOT a sprite sheet. Native square 1254x1254, at least 1024x1024.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is identity authority (face, navy straight hair, short ponytail, gold-jade ornament, blue eyes, blue/ivory/gold scholar robes, gold wave embroidery, white trousers, blue boots, one painted dragon fan). Image2 is approved E10 casting keyframe and GLOBAL CHARACTER SCALE / CAMERA / GROUNDED STANCE authority. Last image is primary approved STYLE reference: clean bright rounded Taoist chibi hand painting with crisp edges, warm ivory and fine soft gold, polished but never plastic. Keep face, costume design and head size consistent.
DIRECTION: faces SCREEN RIGHT, nose right. Near camera-facing arm is anatomical RIGHT and holds ONE open fan by its black pivot; far anatomical LEFT hand is EMPTY and performs the casting gesture.
EXACT UNIQUE PHASE 7/16: 聚气07：左手诀从脸下向前推半掌距离，右扇在头侧最高位置展开，右肘弯，胸廓微提。
Additional exact pose requirement: Charging apex: near RIGHT hand fan raised overhead to the side, pivot at temple height with clearly bent right elbow, fan rim near ponytail top and fully inside canvas. Far LEFT two-finger seal pushes only a HALF PALM forward from chin, NOT full extension. Feet stay exactly as E10; no stepping. Keep upright chest.
Maintain independent real shoulder/elbow/wrist/finger movement from the E10 keyframe according to this phase. The EMPTY left hand performs the seal; RIGHT hand always owns the fan. Keep hands spatially separated and traceable to their correct shoulders, no arm crossing confusion, never duplicate hands, never attach two hands to one sleeve. Fan is physical ivory paper painted with blue water-dragon and waves; no actual water or dragon.
FIXED COMPOSITION AND FOOT CONTACT: Match Image2 large head scale, head top near y=8% and height about 36% of frame. Entire figure including fan and tassels inside canvas, root centered x=50%, virtual floor at y=95%. Character's feet remain planted at the same two casting stance points throughout this action (no stepping, no jumping, no running), soles close to y=95%; preserve knee flexion / torso bend specified by phase. Keep full boots and coherent knees/ankles visible below cloth; no independent per-frame zoom or ground shifting. Full opaque character with genuinely transparent background alpha.
Costume invariants: one ponytail, one open fan in RIGHT hand, jade pendant on anatomical LEFT hip, blue-gold boots, no costume redesign. Focused alert blue eyes aimed at target; no joyful open-mouth smile. Gentle follow-through only in sleeves, cloth and blue tassels according to phase. Preserve original short chibi limbs.
ABSOLUTELY NO effects: no water, glowing seal, energy, particles, aura, detached dragon, attack trail, shadow, floor, scenery, text, border or watermark. Exactly two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand. Single isolated sprite.
